issues.description: The problem statement and the template define Course.ratings as an array of Int (ratings: [Int]), but the solution defines ratings as [Double]. This cross-artifact type mismatch means the reference solution does not match the exercise specification and will confuse students about the intended ratings element type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the ratings element type consistent across all artifacts. Preferably change the solution to use ratings: [Int] (matching the problem and template) and compute averages by converting sums/counts to Double when returning the average. Alternatively, if Double is desired, update the problem statement and template to require [Double] and adjust method implementations accordingly.

issues.description: Within the solution repository, Course.ratings is declared as [Double] but addRating(stars:) accepts Int and appends stars directly and getAverageRating() accumulates ratings into an Int sum. These internal type/usage mismatches will cause compilation errors and are inconsistent within the solution itself.
issues.suggestedFix: Fix the solution's internal type usage so all operations use the same element type. Either: (A) change ratings to [Int], leave addRating(stars: Int) as-is, sum with an Int accumulator and return Double(sum)/Double(count); or (B) if ratings should be [Double], convert the Int stars to Double when appending (ratings.append(Double(stars))) and use a Double accumulator when computing the average.
